instruction: Could you configure the browser to use Startpage as the default search engine?

metadata.explanation: Variation 5: Change default search engine to Startpage. Uses existing get_default_search_engine getter and match_in_list metric. Evaluator accepts both 'Startpage' and 'Startpage.com' as valid names.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads default search engine from Chrome Preferences file (default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name)
Metric correctly checks if result matches expected values using match_in_list
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement (Startpage as default search engine)
Expected values are semantically correct: accepts both 'Startpage' and 'Startpage.com' as valid variations
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted before verification
Data flow is correct: getter extracts string -> metric compares against list -> returns 1.0 for match
Logic will work correctly at runtime with proper error handling in getter
